nom: Philosophy Dose Of Wisdom Dark Circle Brightening Eye Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the moisturizer and serum as rich and helpful for dryness, though a few say it is not moisturizing enough to last through a full day or night.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no burning, irritation, or breakouts and appreciate the low scent, but one sensitive-skin reviewer had burning, itching, and a fragrance reaction to the serum.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature or aging report firmer, smoother, more supple skin and reduced fine lines with regular use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with acne-prone, sensitive, dry skin reports the rich formula did not clog pores or cause breakouts.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, firmer and plumper skin, and a more youthful look with regular use; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the moisturizer and serum as hydrating, leaving skin soft and plump, though a couple found the moisturizer insufficient for very dry skin or overnight use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports the serum does not burn or worsen redness and adds hydration; another with sensitive skin reports burning and itching from the same serum.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the products as non-irritating and comfortable under makeup and moisturizer, supporting a calm, undisrupted skin feel; one reviewer's skin still felt dry the morning after using the moisturizer at night.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the eye cream significantly improved the appearance of dark patches near the eyes over time.
concerns.blemishes: Two reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report no new breakouts from the serum or moisturizer.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the products as lightweight and non-greasy, not weighing down the skin; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: High price for small container size

extraits.titre: Dose of Wisdom Bouncy Skin Reactivating Serum
extraits.texte: Really wanted to love this serum because I was told it's scientifically proven to make a difference. Unfortunately it has a fragrance that made my sinuses begin to run. Also, I have sensitive skin and this made my skin burn and itch.

This serum is worth it all day. I tried it in store and it had the rarer mark of a good quality product that really hydrates many layers into the skin, which is a huge deal for someone with drier skin like myself, especially in the winter. If you pair this with the hope in a jar exfoliating cream (rub it on and the dead skin sloughs right off with the cream). This serum/exfoliate combo is better than average facials. *This isnt the duo exfoliating package that has the scrub and Activating cream i dont want to confuse people. These are separate items. I also use the décolletage cream as well and i use the miracle pump for that area (not the jars those are too heavy/greasy for me). This one looks like a bottle of conditioner but its for your chest. Im pleasantly surprised by these particular products from the philosophy line. Those are the standouts imo!

This is such a beautiful gift set! The moisturizing cream is amazing for dry skin. I have acne-prone, sensitive dry skin and this has done nothing but wonders for my skin as well approach colder months. The formula is rich and creamy, but doesn't clog my pores or cause breakouts. I've been really impressed with how it preforms and plan to purchase more in the future. The set is really nice because it also includes a travel size I can take with me when I go on trips. Highly recommend to anyone who needs a moisture boost & has sensitive or dry skin!!

extraits.titre: The best moisturizing serum for sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: Philosophy dose of wisdom bouncy skin reactivating serum is my absolute favorite serum. As someone who breaks out from everything, this product does not do this. I suffer from rosacea and this does not burn my skin and provides a little extra hydration. It also smells amazing and comes in a glass bottle with dropper.
This was a nicely moisturizing formula. Did not cause me any irritation and sat well under makeup. Did not make a difference in my hereditary dark circles but then again nothing does

I received this Bright Eyes and Bouncy Skin Holiday Set for free from Philosophy and Influenster in exchange for my honest review. Both products have a really nice and light fresh clean scent. As light as it is, there's a calmness to the scent. The Bouncy Skin Reactivating Serum comes in a dropper bottle with a twist top. The texture of the serum is milky and has a bit of thickness to it. The serum absorbed quickly and was slightly tacky, but that feeling went away once the serum was dry. My skin is left feeling and looks very hydrated and refreshed once this serum is applied. I don't have too many lines, but I have noticed some improvement in the smoothness of my forehead and lines around my eyes, more so than on areas such as smile lines. The Bright Eyes Eye Cream is a thick eye cream, and a little goes a long way. I feel a bit of coolness when I first apply the eye cream, and I really like how soft it felt on my undereyes. This cream has definitely helped with puffiness and texture around my eyes, and so far, I've noticed a slight improvement in my undereye darkness. I do have a couple of dark patches near my eyes, and the darkness has improved on those patches with the Bright Eyes Cream significantly. This set would make a good gift for someone into skincare or these items specifically. The packaging is cute enough where you would just need to add a bow. It even has a To/From tag on the box. I could see myself purchasing these items again.

I've been a philosophy gal for a long time! I switched to this serum as my skin matured, and I have not been disappointed! Goes on smooth, my skin drinks it in, great results. I layer it with my moisturizer, and my skin is supple and beautiful!
